newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles toy chain records another loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles toy chain records another loss.

text.p: Australia's largest retailer, Coles Myer Ltd, said on Tuesday it booked an abnormal loss of A$43.4 million, including write-offs of fixtures and inventory, for the restructure of its troubled World 4 Kids toy chain.
The loss was included in the company's overall A$31.5 million pre-tax net abnormal loss for 1995/96 ended July 28.

Coles said in a statement accompanying its results that following a strategic review of World 4 Kids (W4K) chain the company remained committed to the Australian toy and leisure market and would retain the W4K brand.
This would include some stand alone W4K stores, but some stores within the 23-store W4K network would be utilised for other Coles Myer businesses, including Officeworks.
"The reutilisation of the stores will take time to complete and some costs may be incurred during this process," it said.
World 4 Kids, which has been in a pitched battle with the Australian operations of rival Toys R Us, was fully integrated into Kmart discount store business during the last quarter.
The World 4 Kids so-called category killer toy chain has been recording losses since its formation about three years ago.
